data: In this course, students will be introduced to the theory of rings and fields. The language of ring theory and field theory helps describe fundamental relationships between algebra, number theory and geometry and geometry, and provides a unifying framework for describing certain types of number systems and operator spaces.The course will begin with a study of important families of rings such as Euclidean domains, Principal Ideal Domains, and Unique Factorisation Domains. After a brief discussion of polynomial rings over Unique Factorisation Domains, the course will then develop the theory of fields. We will describe how to adjoin roots of polynomials to fields, and introduce the idea of an algebraic field extension. The course will conclude with a discussion on splitting fields.
